52
Uppstått har Herren! Röda havets flod
0:00 / —
SV EN FR

This is a translation of the Swedish lyrics and cannot be sung.

1.

The Lord has risen! The Red Sea’s flood For us He passed through, and with His blood We were dearly bought, He bore our judgment Death is conquered! Jesus’ grave is empty!

2.

Thou hast risen, and in Thy dark grave Our mass of sin was buried, Thy life Thou gavest And didst resume; us judgment can never reach, In life and resurrection we stand.

3.

Thou hast risen, we now Thy life have received And walk the desert path Thy foot has trod. With Thee now one, in the holiness’ rest We may worship, in God’s favour abide.

4.

Thou hast risen, our Redeemer! Severe was the conflict Thou didst endure. Thou didst gain the victory, in glory Thou art, By the Father crowned, we see Thee, Jesus, there!

5.

Our Lord Christ! As Forerunner Thou hast entered, we long to see Thee, Behold all Thy grace and sin no more And eternally, eternally be where Thou art.

Text: Efter The Lord is risen: the Red Sea’s judgment flood av William P. Mackay, 1881. Musik: Toulon av Louis Bourgeois, 1551. 10.10.10.10
